Record Class ProcessView

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
fr.robie.machineengine.api.process.ProcessView
Record Components:
recipe - key of the recipe being processed
status - current status
progress - ticks done
duration - ticks needed (modifiers applied at start)
inFlight - inputs consumed at start and held until completion (D15)
outputs - what completion produces (captured at start)
costPerTick - per-tick costs (modifiers applied at start)
public record ProcessView(@NotNull net.kyori.adventure.key.Key recipe, @NotNull ProcessStatus status, long progress, long duration, @NotNull List<ResourceStack> inFlight, @NotNull List<ResourceStack> outputs, @NotNull List<ResourceStack> costPerTick) extends Record
Read-only view of a running process (ARCHITECTURE.md §13).

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. Reference components are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object); primitive components are compared with the compare method from their corresponding wrapper classes.
